description: Winter Samurai Prep 02 SDF config. Explicitly separates merge_groups from unmerged_meshes so Prep 02a can validate mesh coverage before SDF fusion. VDB target names are allowed to match consumed source mesh names; internal placeholders are used during fusion/import to avoid name collisions.
voxel_note: Retest parameters: voxel_size=1.0, offset=1.5, auto_offset=false for all groups.
notes: The screenshot shows the second helmet mesh as Helm_Partt2, with double 't'. If the actual blend uses Helm_Part2 instead, Prep 02a will fail fast and report the missing declared mesh.
Unmerged meshes are not sent to SDF fusion. They are preserved and validated by Prep 02b against the post-import scene classification.
Final expected mesh names include VDB targets, Source_<VDB> lineage meshes, and unmerged meshes.
Corrected Winter Samurai commercial asset mesh names: Bottle/Bottle2 -> Botle/Botle2.
